    "91f6d0e1: ;\nInitialization of variables and input validation for updating or creating\na new Transcription record for the PATIENT STATUS file (#393).\n\nRequires the variable `DA` to be defined.\nIn the case of a new record, `DA` will be undefined.;\n",

    "6534e9bc: ;If X is '@', execute the Fileman 'Z^DIE2' routine for word-processing fields.",
    "4292d75f: ;If X is a space, the field is a date/time field, and the user has a default value defined, set X to the default value.",

    "fb5d004e: ;Write any remaining characters from the current entry in DU and set X to the value associated with the selected entry.",
    "8192cc5a: ;If the field is a pointer, set up the variables for the Fileman 'DIC' routine and call it. If the selected entry is < 0, branch to the 'X' label.",
    "7be99933: ;If the field is not numeric, branch to the 'V' label. Otherwise, check if the number is too large and, if so, kill X and branch to the 'Z' label.",

    "c9e89f58: ;Execute the computed re-executable routine for the piece.",
    "bd6e85b6: ;Kill any previous data validator code and LAYGO variables. If X is not null, set it in the global and, if the field is a date/time field, set the default value for the user.",
    "009383df: ;Write an alert and, if the piece was selected from the list, branch to 'Z^DIE17'.",
    "75df8305: ;Set X to '?BAD' for an invalid response.",
    "5313d5d0: ;Branch to the DIEQ reader for a '?' response.",
    "6b8ab585: Set the node for the DQ array with the field label, data type, data, IEN, and executable help text.",
    "942131c0: If the field is word-processing, set X to the field value and go to the input reader. Otherwise, if the field is not read-only, allow the user to edit the field value.",
    "d56bf501: If there is an existing value, set DG to the data type, Y to the existing value, and X to the storage location.",
    "f069e59b: If the data type is a pointer to a file entry, find the pointed-to entry and set X to the .01 field value and DG to the global root.",
    "f07bdb6f: If the data type is a pointer to a variable pointer, find the pointed-to entry and set X to the .01 field value and DG to the global root.",
    "5a6c8faa: If the data type is set of codes, find the external value for the internal value.",
    "560da793: If the value is null, set it to the existing value. If the data is not valid, go to the input reader or re-edit the field.",
    "c314035d: If the data type is not MUMPS code or free text, go to the input reader.",
    "f1d16f7c: Execute any MUMPS code in the MUMPS CROSS-REFERENCE field of the data dictionary and go to the input reader or re-edit the field.",
    "7cced0fd: End of routine.",
    "a30bfa90: Set the routine name and starting question number.",
    "780cd545: Set the fields for the DATE SIGNED field: word-processing field, caption, and field number.",
    "a88fe71e: Go to the reader for the DATE SIGNED field.",
    "eef01f63: Executable help for the DATE SIGNED field: set the date/time to the current date/time.",
    "e6d44edf: End of executable help code.",
    "5427ea7d: ;Check if the old date is defined.",
    "cfd9cccd: ;Clear the old date if no new date is entered.",

    "f46425ab: ;End of the post-action.",

  ]
